package_variants.label: Resmî kaynak otoritesi
package_variants.guard: Only official DESNZ/GOV.UK/National Data Library provenance is accepted.

package_variants.label: Güncellik
package_variants.guard: Observed publication/update status is retained and stale editions are not silently treated as current.

package_variants.label: Yayın tarihi
package_variants.guard: Publication and update dates are retained separately from data reference periods.

package_variants.label: Provisional-final ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Provisional estimates never silently supersede final estimates and final estimates are not backfilled into provisional vintages.

package_variants.label: Gelecek yayın ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Future release announcements contain no observed values until the publication exists.

package_variants.label: Revizyon-düzeltme
package_variants.guard: Methodological revision or correction is distinguished from a physical change in emissions.

package_variants.label: Sürüm üstünlüğü
package_variants.guard: Current versions supersede older versions only within the same accounting basis and series.

package_variants.label: Territorial-residence ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Territorial emissions are not mixed with residence-basis environmental accounts.

package_variants.label: Source-end user ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Source and end-user emissions allocations retain their different accounting meanings.

package_variants.label: SIC sektör ayrımı
package_variants.guard: SIC economic allocation is not silently treated as a physical site or parcel allocation.

package_variants.label: Ulusal-parsel ayrımı
package_variants.guard: National totals and national-sector rows are not assigned to individual land parcels.

package_variants.label: Enerji-faaliyet/emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Energy production, trade or consumption is activity data, not direct emissions.

package_variants.label: Yakıt kullanımı-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Fuel quantities require applicable factors and scope before supporting emissions calculations.

package_variants.label: Elektrik üretimi-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Electricity generation or consumption is not itself a greenhouse-gas observation.

package_variants.label: Gaz talebi-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Natural-gas demand is activity evidence and cannot be promoted directly to parcel emissions.

package_variants.label: Petrol talebi-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Oil supply, stocks or demand do not directly measure greenhouse-gas emissions.

package_variants.label: Katı yakıt faaliyet ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Coal and derived-fuel activity must retain fuel, unit, sector and period context before any emissions calculation.

package_variants.label: Yenilenebilir üretim-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Renewable generation or capacity is not automatically an avoided-emissions or parcel-emissions value.

package_variants.label: Enerji dengesi-parsel ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Commodity and energy balances are national/system aggregates and are not parcel binding.

package_variants.label: Arz-talep ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Supply, demand and final consumption retain their distinct balance definitions.

package_variants.label: İthalat-ihracat/emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Energy trade flows are not territorial emissions without a supported emissions treatment.

package_variants.label: Çeyreklik-yıllık ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Quarterly energy or emissions estimates are not substituted for annual series without period alignment.

package_variants.label: Aylık-çeyreklik ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Monthly and quarterly energy tables retain cadence and lag differences.

package_variants.label: Provisional enerji verisi
package_variants.guard: Provisional energy statistics remain provisional and are not treated as settled final activity data.

package_variants.label: Metodoloji revizyonu
package_variants.guard: A methodology update can alter estimates or classifications without representing new physical activity.

package_variants.label: Sektör tanımı
package_variants.guard: Sector-definition changes are preserved and not interpreted as physical emissions changes.

package_variants.label: Çifte sayım kontrolü
package_variants.guard: Modelled reallocations and sector deductions must not be counted twice across source categories.

package_variants.label: Modellenmiş EV tüketimi
package_variants.guard: Modelled electric-vehicle consumption is distinguished from supplier-observed end-use consumption.

package_variants.label: Batarya çıktı-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Battery electricity output is not a direct greenhouse-gas emissions measurement.

package_variants.label: Batarya verimliliği
package_variants.guard: Round-trip efficiency or storage losses are not emissions without a supported electricity-emissions basis.

package_variants.label: Veri merkezi tüketimi
package_variants.guard: Data-centre electricity consumption estimates do not directly establish facility or parcel emissions.

package_variants.label: Hidrojen üretimi-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Hydrogen production or demand quantities do not by themselves quantify lifecycle greenhouse-gas emissions.

package_variants.label: Geliştirme istatistiği
package_variants.guard: Statistics in development retain their quality/status caveats and are not promoted to higher certainty.

package_variants.label: Clean Power yoğunluğu
package_variants.guard: Grid emissions intensity is a system-level ratio and not an absolute parcel emissions value.

package_variants.label: Yoğunluk-mutlak ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Intensity metrics are never treated as absolute emissions without an aligned denominator.

package_variants.label: Enerji yoğunluğu-emisyon ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Energy intensity is not emissions intensity unless the numerator explicitly represents emissions.

package_variants.label: Pay-payda uyumu
package_variants.guard: Intensity calculations require aligned numerator, denominator, activity coverage and time period.

package_variants.label: Endüstriyel son kullanım
package_variants.guard: Modelled industrial end-use allocations are not direct measurements of process emissions.

package_variants.label: ECUK-DUKES uyumu
package_variants.guard: ECUK disaggregation and DUKES balances retain their distinct methods and aggregation levels.

package_variants.label: Veri toplama-ölçüm ayrımı
package_variants.guard: Survey, supplier or administrative data collection is distinguished from direct physical emissions measurement.

package_variants.label: Birim-payda kontrolü
package_variants.guard: Units and denominators must match before values can be compared or combined.

package_variants.label: Zaman dönemi kontrolü
package_variants.guard: Publication date, data year, month, quarter and annual period are not conflated.

package_variants.label: Lisans-provenance
package_variants.guard: Official source provenance and Open Government Licence context are retained where applicable.

package_variants.label: Agrega-parsel ayrımı
package_variants.guard: National, sector, fuel and system aggregates are not silently assigned to a cadastral parcel.

package_variants.label: Gözlenen-gelecek sınırı
package_variants.guard: Observed current statistics are strictly separated from scheduled or planned future publications and methods.

package_variants.label: Desteksiz parsel çıkarımı yok
package_variants.guard: No parcel emissions value is inferred without explicit parcel binding and supported measurement or calculation inputs.
